body:
origin/integration is now aa5de5d5ec7: #4024 (aida ps points at aida land status, Refs STORY-2768, head fa19c00a58db) merged under review-after-merge (one printed line, low risk; the branch sat directly on 4a8875e2aa1, so the merge result is the tree that passed check-ci-fast, 48 gates, and dell1). It needs a verdict at fa19c00a58db before the next promotion is cut: please schedule one.
New work, asked for by Joe's review session (aida-19) and inside the normal path: BUG-2576, PRs into integration run no CI (ci.yml pull_request: branches: [main]). That is why #4007 was approved at a head that could not pass the fast gate. Branch bug-2576-integration-pr-ci has the one-line fix; the PR follows when check-ci-fast passes, review before merge. The bug is filed Draft: please promote it to Approved.
Still waiting on you: review of #4022 (STORY-2772 slice 1); a verdict for #4007 at d6eb35f081fd; signoff and six rulings on the STORY-2768 slice 3 sketch; word that #3992 landed.
subject: integration at aa5de5d5ec7 (#4024 review-after-merge); BUG-2576 CI for integration PRs
